description: Per-SECOND performance for TikTok ad videos — which second viewers swipe away on, the share still watching at 2s and 3s, and the biggest single drop: the hook read for the next variation. reportType AD (default) reads ads by adIds, adgroupIds or campaignIds with per-second views, clicks, drop-offs, likes and shares; reportType VIDEO reads ONE video’s lifetime retain/drop-off curve by videoId. Covers the first 60 seconds; data lags about an hour; an ad that never served has none. Read-only, free.

adgroupIds.description: ad group ids to read (AD report)

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

materialId.description: creative material id to read one specific material

reportType.description: AD (default) reads ads by adIds, adgroupIds or campaignIds; VIDEO reads one video by videoId

videoId.description: VIDEO report: one video id from upload_tiktok_ads_creative

name: tiktok_ads_video_retention
title: TikTok per-second video retention
